entry.name: jit.gl.model
entry.digest: Read and draw various 3D model formats
entry.description: jit.gl.model Reads and draws a variety of 3D model formats, such as OBJ, Collada, and Blender. Only tessellated polygons are drawn, and surfaces that are not tessellated are converted before drawing. Certain model formats, such as Collada, support skinned animation.

attributes.name: animblendmode
attributes.digest: Animation blend mode
attributes.description: Determine how multiple enabled animations will be blended (default = 0 - Average).

choices.digest: Weights will be averaged to equal 1
Weights will be added and can go greater than 1

attributes.name: drawgroup
attributes.digest: Mesh draw group
attributes.description: If non-zero, draw only one mesh. If zero, draw all mesh groups in the model (default = 0).

attributes.name: drawskeleton
attributes.digest: Skeleton draw flag
attributes.description: If enabled draw a wireframe representation of the bones in the model (default = 0).

attributes.name: find_instances
attributes.digest: Mesh instance removal on import
attributes.description: Mesh instance removal on import (default = 1). An optional post-processing step when importing the model file. Instanced meshes are removed by referencing one parent.

attributes.name: fix_normals
attributes.digest: Fix normals on import
attributes.description: Fix normals on import (default = 0). An optional post-processing step when importing the model file. Tries to fix normal vectors that are facing inwards.

attributes.name: index_matrixoutput
attributes.digest: Enable index matrixoutput
attributes.description: Enable index matrixoutput mode (default = 0). When enabledmode will output a list of two matrix names. The first contains unique shared vertex data, and the second contains index data as a single planedata type matrix. The mesh can be reconstructed by sending the vertex data to the first inlet ofand the index data to last (theinlet).

attributes.name: material_mode
attributes.digest: Material mode
attributes.description: Mode for applying built-in material properties of a model. (default = 1 - Diffuse)

choices.digest: Only diffuse color component is used

attributes.name: nodeaxes
attributes.digest: Show axes at nodes
attributes.description: If non-zero, draw a RGB axes at the location of all the nodes in the model.

attributes.name: normalize
attributes.digest: Normalize model coordinates
attributes.description: Normalize model coordinates flag (default = 1). When enabled, the model is scaled to the range (-1.,1.) for the x, y, and z axes.

attributes.name: numanimations
attributes.digest: Number of animations
attributes.description: Indicates the number of animations in the model.

attributes.name: numgroups
attributes.digest: Number of mesh groups
attributes.description: Indicates the number of mesh groups. A mesh group consists of vertex data and material data.

attributes.name: optimize
attributes.digest: Optimize vertices and nodes on import
attributes.description: Optimize vertices and nodes on import (default = 1). An optional post-processing step when importing the model file. Identical vertices are jointed to optimize indexing, small meshes are joined if possible, and Nodes with no data assigned are collapsed and joined.

attributes.digest: Verbose mode
attributes.description: Verbose mode flag (default = 0). If enabled, messages useful for debugging are printed to the Max Console.

messages.name: animenable
messages.description: Enable a model animation. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index to enable. Otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animloop
messages.description: Enable/disable looping on an animation. Looping on animations is enabled by default. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index to enable. Otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animlooppoints
messages.description: Set the loop points of an animation, if looping is currently enabled on that animation. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index to enable. Otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animrate
messages.description: Set an animation's rate. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index, otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animreset
messages.description: Reset the state of an animation. Time is set to 0., rate to 1., weight to 1., and the loop points are set to the beginning and end of the animation. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index to enable. Otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animtime
messages.description: Jump to a specific time, in seconds, of an animation. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index, otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: animweight
messages.description: Set an animation's weight which determines how much influence the animation has on the affected mesh. If two arguments are provided, the first is the animation index, otherwise the current animation is used.

messages.name: copynodestoclipboard
messages.digest: Copy all nodes to the clipboard
messages.description: Copy all nodes in the model asobjects, to the clipboard. When the nodes are pasted in the patch, they will control the internal nodes of the model. Make sure theattribute is set before using this feature.

messages.name: dispose
messages.digest: Unload the model file and free all resources

messages.name: getanim_dict
messages.description: Send a description of the animation atas a dictionary out the dumpout.

messages.name: getanimnames
messages.description: Sends a list of the scenes named animations out the dumpout. Some model files don't support named animations, and therefore the names will not be sent, even though animations are present.

messages.name: getbonenames
messages.description: Sends a list of the bones currently loaded in the model, if any, out the dumpout.

messages.name: getmaterial_dict
messages.description: Send a description of thematerial as a dictionary out the dumpout. If no argument, use the currentattribute.

messages.name: getnodenames
messages.description: Sends a list of the scene nodes currently loaded in the model out the dumpout.

messages.name: gettexnames
messages.description: Sends a list of all the textures currently loaded in the model out the dumpout.

messages.name: nodeanimenable
messages.description: Toggle the animation of the named node. If disabled, model animations will have no effect on that node.

messages.name: nodebind
messages.description: Takes two args, the name of the node in the model to bind, and the name of anobject to bind to.

messages.name: nodereset
messages.description: Resets the named node in the model to it's initial spatial transform state.

messages.name: nodesetinitial
messages.description: Sets the named nodes initial transform state to it's current transform.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Load a model file from disk
messages.description: Loads an model file from disk. Themessage will attempt to find the model file in the Max search path and load it. If no file name is specified, a file dialog box is presented.

messages.name: sendmaterial
messages.description: Send the internal material fora message. Seefor possible messages and attributes.

messages.name: sendtexture
messages.digest: Send a named texture a message
messages.description: Send the internal named texture a message. Seefor possible messages and attributes.

messages.name: texgroup
messages.digest: Apply a named texture to a mesh group
messages.description: Themessage is used to apply a named texture to a specific mesh within the model. The model's mesh-groups are specified in its model file. The texture applied to a group will override any textures which have been applied to the object using theattribute, and textures loaded from the model file.
